Message.descriptionEn: Log text, at most 2000 characters, with ANSI escape sequences stripped.
Message.description_en: The log text (<= 2000 characters, with ANSI escape codes stripped)
Message.example: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.00 GiB
Message.title: 日志文本（<=2000，已剥 ANSI）

TimestampMs.descriptionEn: Millisecond timestamp of the log line.
TimestampMs.description_en: The millisecond timestamp of the log line
TimestampMs.title: 日志行毫秒时间戳

description_en: Retrieves the context of a specific exception log for a DLC job
description_zh: 获取DLC作业某条异常日志的上下文
name: GetRLLogContext

parameters.help_en: The timestamp of the anchor log line in UTC RFC 3339 format with second precision
parameters.help_zh: 锚点日志行时间（UTC RFC3339，秒级）
parameters.name: anchor_time

parameters.example: [rank0]: torch.OutOfMemoryError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.00 GiB
parameters.help_en: The text of the anchor log. The fallback path locates the log by prefix matching. This value is derived from Fatal[].RawMessage
parameters.help_zh: 锚点日志文案（回退路径按前缀匹配定位；来自 Fatal[].RawMessage）
parameters.name: anchor_message

parameters.help_en: The agent_collect_time of the anchor line as a nanosecond string. This value is derived from Fatal[].CollectNs. If provided, the exact path is used
parameters.help_zh: 锚点行 agent_collect_time（纳秒字符串，来自 Fatal[].CollectNs）；提供时走精确路径
parameters.name: collect_time

AnchorIndex.description_en: The index of the anchor line in Lines. This value is empty if the fallback path does not match the anchor. In this case, Lines contains all lines in the window
AnchorIndex.description_zh: 锚点行在 Lines 中的下标；回退路径未匹配到锚点时为空（Lines 为全窗口行）

Lines.description_en: The context log lines in ascending order of time

items.description_en: A single line of content from the log file

Mode.description_en: The log locating mode. Valid values: agent_collect_time for the exact path, and raw_time_cluster for the fallback path
Mode.description_zh: agent_collect_time（精确路径）/ raw_time_cluster（回退路径）

Truncated.description_en: Indicates whether the number of raw lines in the fallback path reaches the upper limit of 5,000
Truncated.description_zh: 回退路径原始行达到 5000 上限时为 true

schema.title_en: RL 日志上下文响应体
schema.title_zh: RL 日志上下文响应体
